t: The Milwaukee Premium Concrete Drill Bit, 7mm x 150mm, is engineered for reliable drilling into tough materials. Featuring a tungsten-carbide-tipped (TCT) design, it effortlessly tackles concrete, aerated concrete blocks, masonry, slate, and granite. Ideal for construction, installation, and general building work. 3-Flat straight shank prevents slipping in the chuck, ensuring improved control and stability during use. The distinctive red flute allows for quick identification in any toolbox. Suitable for both hammer and rotary drilling modes, this masonry drill bit delivers dependable performance for trade professionals.
